name: Strongman Conditioning
description: An add-on for any program: two finishers a week of sled pushes and drags, car pushes and pulls, farmer's carries and atlas stones. Skipped in taper and test weeks.
rounding: nearest plate increment: round(tm * percent / 100 / increment) * increment
